effect: At a bracket's bottom, GingerCraven clears hinge on where its fear lands and how long; 35% clears end with 0.6–1.8 s left.
mitigation: Dedicated deck (Scorpion poison to 20, Brightseeker on the boss), DR perks and pets, retries; boss auto-summon retries unattended.

factor: Accuracy and focus below the stage's requirement
effect: Below the accuracy requirement attacks miss (about 10% more per 100 short); below focus, debuffs fail. At 15% and in the Rift, a few misses decide it.
mitigation: Meet the stage's accuracy requirement (1,203.5 caps it from about chapter 248) or at least 900–1,000 after the easing; raise focus for debuffers.

effect: Pomegranate's beam and ATK-targeted perks go to the top-ATK cookies; with the wrong cookie on top, the carry misses them.
mitigation: Check ATK order in battle; steer with rune ATK lines, or lower Skating Queen and Cherry Cola a level or two, Pinot Noir to Lv.75.

effect: On auto, Cherry Cola runs ahead and drags Milk away, so Brightseeker loses Milk's buff; the same deck clears by hand.
mitigation: Drop Cherry Cola from auto decks unless Bari is in, or play the opening by hand.

effect: A Rift level either sheds 20–30% of the boss's HP in a try or doesn't move; the difference is mostly 차원의 힘 level, not luck.
mitigation: Give a level about five tries, then park in the Rift and let 차원의 힘 level up.
